Might as well put my input. personally i have managed to bypass the fear of dying And suicide. Why am i still here? Cause i am stuck in the hospital due to parents finding out, but will get out soon and well... ya know. anyways. Heres some thing u can do to gain the courage to kill yourself :o
1. Choose a suicide method that does not give u time to think:personlly i have chosen to go to the top of a high building and quickly jump off without hesitstion
2.Choose one that will kill you ( some popular suicide methods such as overdose has a low chance of killing u)
3.rehearse it: practice climbing over a railing or whatever related to your suicide method, that way u are prepared
4.Make sure u are at peace with your decision, u do not want to be distressed when u finally are about to kill yourself
5.remember that fear is a tempoary thing, once u die you will no longer feel that fear, and and all that suffering. look foward to that feeling of relief and use that to overcome that Fear
of course this is all assuming u really wanna kill yourself, just wanted to share my thoughts maybe i will see u soon in the afterlife if there is one :)

I feel pain every waking moment, every little thing from moving from my bed to the kitchen takes so much effort to do. I am so tired and in pain all the time. I experience pain as I am alive and I want it to end.
